The '''Mark of Victory''' was an award given by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Thelonia Redrish]] received the Mark and the rank of [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Republic Army]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].
